prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE entirely new production sprite for the Four Realms playing-card skin in Balatro Portrait. This is NEW ART from scratch. ONE cohesive classic Balatro-compatible chunky pixel-art style across the set. The final illustration is imported into a 47-by-79-pixel art area inside a native 71-by-95 playing card, so design for extremely small mobile readability. Treat the art as a native roughly 45-by-73-pixel bitmap, enlarged with nearest-neighbor: large flat clusters, uniform dark 1-pixel outlines, at most 12 deliberate colours, 2 or 3 shade steps per material, simple hard edge highlights, clear negative spaces. No soft painting, antialiasing, gradients, blur, grain, dithering, intricate linework, tiny jewellery or detailed fabric patterns. Transparent background, isolated upright portrait with even 8% transparent margins, no card stock, card border, ranks, letters, suit index, writing, logo or watermark. For court figures, use ONE single waist-up upright figure (not mirrored, not full body, no second head), face at upper third large and readable, shoulders and hands contained in a narrow portrait silhouette, same character scale throughout all courts, large graphic costumes and one clear signature object. No Joker hat or jester costume. For aces use ONE centred suit-theme emblem, same bold outline and graphic cluster style. Deliver portrait proportions, fully within frame, genuinely transparent background. Subject: CLUBS KING. An ORIGINAL ancient herbal king with a strong warm olive face, a substantial moss-green beard, a golden circlet with three cannabis leaf points, deep green mantle, carved wooden pipe and a leaf-tipped staff. Powerful earthy woodland ruler. A single pale mint smoke curl, dark forest shadows and lime accents.
